sample_unit: brain MRI reports (radiologist evaluation); 30-report subset for non-physician evaluation

links.outcome: Overall error rate in LLM-generated lay summaries of brain MRI reports
links.effect: Overall error rate in LLM-generated lay summaries was 19.7% (62/315), warranting expert oversight.
links.quote: Overall error rate in LLM-generated lay summaries was 19.7% (62/315), warranting expert oversight.

unlisted_practices: On-premise open-weights LLMs to preserve privacy when summarizing radiology reports

screen.reason: Evaluates performance and safety (error rates, readability/comprehension) of open-weights LLMs generating lay summaries from MRI reports evaluated by radiologists and non-physicians, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
